question: served-recipe hurricane RI v8.2 vs NOAA operational RI guidance on the same held-out cases
truth: evaluation label: best-track wind(t+24h) - wind(t) >= 30 kt at synoptic t; SHIPS-RII's own threshold is the same (>= 30 kt / 24 h), so no second threshold is needed

RIOD.product: SHIPS-RII (the Rapid Intensification Index; linear-discriminant version)
RIOD.evidence: NHC Ian (AL092022) discussions quote SHIPS-RII values that equal RIOD and no other e-deck tech: #6 (12Z 24 Sep) 67% for 65 kt/72 h (RIOD 67; RIOB 60, RIOL 82, RIOC 70), #7 (18Z 24 Sep) 66% 65 kt/72 h (RIOD 66; 39/82/62), #14 (12Z 26 Sep) 73% 35 kt/24 h and 79% 45 kt/36 h (RIOD 73 and 79; RIOB 59/17, RIOL 64/42, RIOC 65/46)

RIOL.evidence: tech letter (L) and membership of the RIOC consensus; no quoted value checked

RIOB.evidence: tech letter (B) and membership of the RIOC consensus; no quoted value checked

RIOC.product: SHIPS RI consensus = mean(RIOD, RIOL, RIOB)
RIOC.evidence: RIOC equals the mean of RIOB/RIOD/RIOL within 1 point in 45,579 of 45,580 2020-2024 records with all four present (one outlier); SHIPS text output labels the same average 'Consensus' of SHIPS-RII/Logistic/Bayesian

DTOP.product: DTOPS (Deterministic to Probabilistic Statistical RI model)
DTOP.evidence: NHC Helene (AL092024) discussion #10 (18Z 25 Sep): DTOPS 'at least a 90 percent chance of a 35-kt increase over the next 24 hours' = DTOP 90 (every other tech <= 62; DTPE does not exist in 2024); Ian 2022 #8-#10 DTOPS '>90%' at 48/72 h consistent with DTOP 91-95

SDCN.product: SDCON-like consensus of RIOC and DTOP (2024 e-decks only)
SDCN.evidence: equals mean(RIOC, DTOP) within 1 point in 5,524 of 5,928 2024 records (93.2%)

EIOD.product: E-prefixed twin of RIOD (unverified; possibly the ECMWF-driven SHIPS run)

EIOC.product: E-prefixed twin of RIOC = mean(EIOB, EIOD, EIOL)

model.served_artifact_note: calibration fitted on 2022-2024 = the test seasons: AUC honest (members <= 2021), Brier/reliability in-sample for 2 parameters

input_source_bias.note: SHIPS-RII initial intensity = e-deck V_final - dV of its 30kt/24h record; the truth is best-track wind(t+24) - best-track wind(t), so a real-time V(t) that is too low/high shifts RII's baseline while v8.2 is scored on the best-track baseline itself

variants.v8_2_C_operational_inputs: scripts/fetch_and_score.py build_live_case on the archived a-deck truncated at t: the analysis is OFCL tau 0 (as live), which carries no pressure
variants.v8_2_C_operational_carq_inputs: the same builder with OFCL removed, so the analysis is CARQ tau 0 -- SHIPS-RII's own real-time initial conditions, with pressure: the input-source comparison without the live defect
